comprehension.scope: Conditional deterministic scalar reachability over finite sequences; no calibrated probability, physical aging qualification, or firmware readiness claim.
comprehension.drift_induction: For each valid containing interval and nonnegative drift budget, endpoint addition/subtraction contains the next state. The one-sided versions follow when evolution has the stated monotone direction. Induction accumulates the drift budgets; intersections preserve containment only when each additional constraint is independently valid for the same state.
comprehension.no_rate_construction: For every positive elapsed time, the piecewise linear admissible increasing trajectory reaches U. The positive bump has finite positive integral and a smooth cumulative integral constant outside [0,1]; time rescaling preserves smoothness and monotonicity while allowing arbitrarily fast traversal. The decreasing construction follows by sign reversal.
comprehension.endpoint_and_quiet_period_cases: The impossibility claim is restricted to p0<U for increasing trajectories and p0>L for decreasing ones. An increasing state already at U must remain there; near U the remaining interval can be arbitrarily narrow. Analogous conclusions hold at L for decrease. Thus the proof correctly avoids claiming every quiet-period interval must be wide.
comprehension.thermal_and_evidence_scope: Reference-condition monotonicity does not imply monotonicity after multiplication by a temperature-dependent factor. Joint uncertainty and qualified physical evolution are required to transport thermal effects and old measurements to the current state; scalar boxes do not establish independence.

remaining_application_obligations: Qualify physical reference-condition health support, monotonicity assumptions, and quantitative aging/evolution restrictions before selecting numerical propagation bounds.
Qualify joint thermal laws and model-error bounds before transporting reference-condition health to operating-condition quantities.
Establish validity of every measurement/support intersection, preserve chronological state transport and dependence, and do not count old measurements as stationary current evidence.
Provide a proved joint reachable-set superset where coupling matters; scalar marginal containment alone supplies no probability coverage.
If using a spline or codebook to bound evolution, bound admissible coefficients, time scales, and physical approximation remainder.
Prove bounded-memory implementation and resource limits separately; this finite-sequence theorem is not a deployed or lifetime certificate.
review_method: Fresh-context direct mathematical review of the current proof only, after AGENTS.md, README introduction and PROJECT_STATE stage/objective/unattended_assurance. No prior proof versions or reviews read; no production or proof edits.
